keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Chelsea 0, Tottenham Hotspur 0.
Second Half begins Chelsea 0, Tottenham Hotspur 0.
Delay in match because of an injury James Maddison (Tottenham Hotspur).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Conor Gallagher replaces James Maddison because of an injury.
Substitution, Chelsea. Marco Palestra replaces Jorrel Hato.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Dominic Solanke replaces Omar Marmoush.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Pedro Porro replaces Andy Robertson.
Conor Gallagher (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Micky van de Ven (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Micky van de Ven Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Mateus Fernandes (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Estêvão replaces Geovany Quenda.
Own Goal by Mike Penders, Chelsea. Chelsea 0, Tottenham Hotspur 1.
Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Cole Palmer (Chelsea) for a bad foul.
Goal! Chelsea 0, Tottenham Hotspur 2. Mathys Tel (Tottenham Hotspur) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Chelsea. Danny Welbeck replaces Pedro Neto.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Ben Davies replaces Mathys Tel.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Dejan Kulusevski replaces Mohammed Kudus.
Morgan Rogers (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Chelsea 0, Tottenham Hotspur 2.
